textureVariants: GLBs reference the 1k KTX2 files by relative uri. Quality tiers that want 2k rewrite "_1k.ktx2" to "_2k.ktx2" in a LoadingManager URL modifier; every texture has both files.
customAttributes: three.js GLTFLoader lower-cases custom attributes: _FIN_MASK is geometry attribute "_fin_mask" (0 rigid body, 1 fin tip) and _FIN_ID is "_fin_id" (0 body, 1 caudal, 2 dorsal, 3 anal, 4 pectoral, 5 pelvic). Anemone tentacle sway is "_sway" (0 base, 1 tip).
